answer_1.quote: In this work, we introduce SAFESTEER, an inference-time method for safety steering of LLMs that requires no additional training or fine-tuning.
answer_1.outputs: generated responses to harmful prompts, steered toward safety while maintaining contextual relevance

answer_2.quote: We use the reduction in the percentage of unsafe responses (%UR) from steered generation compared to naive generation as our metric.

answer_3.quote: We use OpenAI's GPT-4 as the safety classifier (detailed prompt is in Appendix E.1).
